## Overview {#overview}

::: {.msm-prose}
MSM works on the cross-scale modelling of farm systems. The group places a strong emphasis on **hybrid modelling** — integrating different types of models, such as biophysical, hydrological, ecological, farm and market models, with data-driven artificial-intelligence models. It develops methods for combining models with data from sensors, remote sensing and climate products, and links simulation with indicator frameworks to assess the sustainability and resilience of cropping systems.

The work spans fields, farms, landscapes, regions and markets. It aims to support farmers and policymakers in operational, tactical and strategic decision-making. A particular focus is on forecasting and evaluating changes driven by climate, market dynamics and policy.
:::

```{=html}
<ol class="msm-ladder" aria-label="Spatial and organisational scales addressed by MSM">
  <li>Field<small>crops &amp; soils</small></li>
  <li>Farm<small>management</small></li>
  <li>Landscape<small>land use</small></li>
  <li>Region<small>production systems</small></li>
  <li>Market<small>value chains &amp; policy</small></li>
</ol>
```

## Mission & objectives {#mission}

::: {.msm-prose}
**Mission.** To provide robust, cross-scale model-based evidence on how farm and cropping systems respond to climate, market and policy change, and to translate that evidence into decision support for farmers and policymakers.
:::

```{=html}
<ul class="msm-cards cols-2" style="margin-top:1.6rem">
  <li class="msm-card"><span class="ico"><i class="fa-solid fa-diagram-project" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
    <h3>Integrate models and AI</h3><p>Couple biophysical, hydrological, ecological, farm and market models with data-driven AI models in hybrid modelling frameworks.</p></li>
  <li class="msm-card"><span class="ico"><i class="fa-solid fa-satellite-dish" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
    <h3>Combine models with data</h3><p>Develop methods to bring together models and data from sensors, remote sensing and climate products.</p></li>
  <li class="msm-card"><span class="ico"><i class="fa-solid fa-scale-balanced" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
    <h3>Assess sustainability &amp; resilience</h3><p>Link simulations with indicator frameworks to assess the sustainability and resilience of cropping systems.</p></li>
  <li class="msm-card"><span class="ico"><i class="fa-solid fa-chess-knight" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
    <h3>Support decisions</h3><p>Inform operational, tactical and strategic decisions of farmers and policymakers by forecasting and evaluating the effects of climate, market dynamics and policy.</p></li>
</ul>
```
